citations.quote: Mr. client, I know it may look like the market has stopped. But reality is, the market shifted.

observation.text: The statement provides an explanation of the market shift by contrasting the initial appearance of a stopped market with the reality of a changing market.

citations.quote: Demand didn't disappear. Buyers became more selective.

observation.text: The speaker supports the claim that the market has not stopped by stating that demand didn't disappear, thereby warranting the shift explanation.

citations.quote: I know it may look like the market has stopped. But reality is, the market shifted.

summary.text: The market has not stopped; it has shifted.

citations.quote: Now, people are buying very smart. Demand didn't disappear. Buyers became more selective.

summary.text: Buyers are now buying very smart, and demand has not disappeared, but buyers have become more selective.
